comparison.objective: Fasten two aluminium strips with a blind rivet and dispose of the stem.
comparison.physical_skill: Load and align a rivet; hold a riveter square; pump its hinged handles under axial force.
comparison.success_condition: Rivet set without crooked/loose pull, stem binned, tool returned and released; explicit partial and damage criteria.
comparison.reason: Fastener insertion and powered hand-tool actuation do not test aperture-based granular separation, bridge clearing, or retaining larger parts in a screen.
